text:
Gabi: Quick pattern proposal — collapse related areas into a compact hierarchy (e.g., Monitoring > Alerts / Metrics / Dashboards) but ensure deep links still land and the rail expands without URL hacks. Sketch: https://figma.redwood/compact-hierarchy.png :sparkles:
Eli: Love the declutter. Two operational constraints: 1) canonical URLs must not change (so links remain shareable), 2) avoid a visible flash where the page loads with the group collapsed then expands.
Noor: For (2) we should hydrate server-rendered initial sidebar state based on the incoming path before paint. If SSR can't resolve it, fall back to a client replaceState after first render to avoid breadcrumb flicker. Pseudocode: `const node = findNodeForPath(path); if (node) preopen(node.ancestors); else markUnknownPath();`
Theo: Accessibility: when auto-expanding on load, we should announce via a polite live region "Monitoring expanded" and move focus to the selected leaf only on hard loads/bookmarks — not on in-app transitions. Also honor `prefers-reduced-motion` for any expand animation.
Gabi: Breadcrumb rule: breadcrumbs should be stable canonical paths with display names (Dashboard > MyApp > Alerts > alert-123). Use displayName where available; fallback to slug. Dont show the group label twice.
Eli: Routing matching detail: prefer exact static-prefix matches first (count static segments), then longest overall pattern, then sidebar order as deterministic fallback when collisions occur. Telemetry: if match is ambiguous log an analytic event with available candidates so we can refine patterns.
Noor: Implementation note: client hydrate should run before first paint where possible and use `document.documentElement.style.visibility = 'hidden'` briefly if necessary to avoid UI jump (unhide immediately after adjustments). This is controversial but reduces UX jank on deep links. Add a reduced-motion variant that skips the hide trick.
Theo: Keyboard behaviour: group headers should be buttons supporting Enter/Space and arrow keys per WAI-ARIA tree guidelines. When expanded via keyboard, focus should move into the newly revealed first child. When expanded via external deep link, focus lands on the targeted child (initial load only).
Gabi: Tiny copy tweak: group toggle label should be contextual: "Show Alerts" / "Hide Alerts" for SR clarity. Also the breadcrumb separator should be "›" not "/" (visual preference).
Eli: Edge-case: landing on a path that points to a removed item should redirect to parent canonical (301 server-side) and show a dismissible banner: "The item you requested was removed; showing Alerts list." Keep canonical breadcrumbs accurate.
Noor: Tests: unit test for findNodeForPath match ordering, integration test for hydrate-with-preopen (ensures no breadcrumb flicker), E2E for deep link landing behaviour with reduced-motion toggle, and a11y test asserting live region message.
Theo: Dev ops note: normalize duplicate slashes and trailing slash on the server with 301s to a canonical form to avoid duplicate breadcrumb states. Client should also run a URL normalization step on navigation.
Gabi: I'll assemble a short RFC and Figma frames with the reduced-motion variant. Tagging @Eli and @Noor for implementation and @Theo for a11y checks. Also voting: reaction :thumbsup: for keeping accent marker on the group header instead of a child-only underline.
Eli: :thumbsup:
Noor: :eyes:
a11y-bot: Reminder: include SR announcement samples, role/button/aria-expanded semantics, and a skip-link in the header for keyboard landings.
